Live Farmer Dashboard & Persistent Farm Twin

8 AUTHENTIC MISSIONS CONNECTED SLIDE 03 / 07
ORBITAL NASA MULTI-MISSION TELEMETRY

NASA 8-Mission Telemetry & 22-Resource Network

Authentic multi-satellite observation datasets from NASA DAACs with zero synthetic data

  • 8 Calibrated NASA Missions: SMAP (soil moisture), GPM IMERG (precipitation anomalies), NASA POWER (solar & GDD), Landsat 8/9 (30m NDVI/LST), MODIS (250m VCI), ECOSTRESS (evapotranspiration & ESI), GRACE-FO (groundwater), and SRTM (30m elevation & slope).
  • 10-Year Climatology Baseline: 10-year monthly precipitation and temperature curves against 2026 data for drought and heat shock detection.
  • Official 22-Resource Harmonization Matrix: Maps USDA/USGS datasets to certified Indian agronomic equivalents (ICAR-SLUSI, AGMARKNET, PDKV Vertisol taxonomy).
  • Absolute Data Provenance: Every observation carries exact dataset citations, observation timestamp, spatial resolution, and NSIDC/GES DISC DAAC links with zero synthetic data.

EXPLAINABLE AI (XAI) ENGINE SLIDE 04 / 07
MULTI-CRITERIA DECISION OPTIMIZATION

Smart Crop Rotation Engine & Explainable AI

Dynamic priority-weighted rotation scenarios with 8-dimension transparent audit

  • 9 Field Parameters Form: Analyzes current crop, previous crop, soil texture, soil pH (5.5–8.8 slider), water availability, season, and farm acreage.
  • 7 Farmer Priority Toggles: Income Maximization, Soil Health, Water Saving, Fertilizer Cost Reduction, Pest Disruption, Yield, and Climate Resilience.
  • 3 Comparative Rotation Strategies: Compares Strategy A (Conventional Monoculture), Strategy B (Soil Health Chickpea + Summer Dhaincha), and Strategy C (Water Conservation Safflower).
  • 8-Dimension Explainable AI (XAI): Why This Crop, NASA Evidence, Soil Health Impact (+0.22% SOC), Water Impact (1.7M L saved), Financial Impact, Risk Analysis, Info Gaps, Confidence Score.

CIB&RC INTEGRATED PEST MANAGEMENT SLIDE 06 / 07
DIAGNOSTICS & PSYCHROMETRIC SAFETY

AI Plant Disease Doctor & Smart Spraying Advisory

Photographic leaf inspection with confidence grading & Stull Delta-T spray safety

  • Vision Disease Diagnostic: Farmers capture/upload leaf photos; AI identifies crop, disease, visible damage, and calibrated confidence (92.4% for Gram Pod Borer).
  • Organic First Treatments: Recommends 5% Neem Extract (NSKE), HaNPV bio-virus, and bird perches before advising synthetic chemicals, with KVK escalation thresholds.
  • Automated 72h Micro-Forecast: Pulls Open-Meteo hourly forecast without manual sliders, evaluating drift hazards (>15 km/h) and rainfast wash-off (>35% rain).
  • Stull (2011) Delta-T Envelope: Calculates wet-bulb depression (T - Tw, 2°–8°C) to prevent droplet evaporation or thermal inversion drift.
